notes.title: BETA access
notes.content:
Dear players, we decided to open access to the closed version of the game. 

To do this, you need to go to the Beta section in the game settings in the library and there enter the code for access “sketchpioneer”. Then switch to the beta version of “multiplayerbeta”

If the game will not update itself, then uninstall the old version and reinstall the game. 

A voxel-based level editor and multiplayer will be available to you.
Unfortunately, the game was frozen and it's an unfinished game.

Have fun!

notes.title: Sketch Tales: freezing and restart
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10001480/6b31c3060310d1fe7d89b4660df9480c7261e2a7.jpg[/img]

My name is Alexey Sityanov, I'm the project leader of Sketch Tales, and  I’ve got two news for you.

1. We decided to freeze the Sketch Tales, and it seems there is no turning back.
2. We decided to restart the Sketch Tales, develop F2P version as an online world with the same history and possibilities.

Many times I postponed this letter and it didn’t come easily. Sketch Tales is an essential project for me, and I do not want to call it quits. However, in the current form, the Sketch Tales is impossible without serious funding. Also, the project has many difficulties with the technologies we have chosen. After a couple of years of searching and trying to negotiate with publishers we have to admit that there is no funding for the current version of the game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10001480/08765c7eee20ea63f79d1e2f490b5e284f803b3f.jpg[/img]

Sketch Tales is an experimental and very innovative project. In it, we tried to do a lot of things, which no one else has done before us. A live RPG world that you can not only draw but also play in with friends. When we started, we could not imagine with what we will face. When we reached a certain point, our money just ran out. And as I wrote earlier, we did not find the new one. Also, we found ourself mired in a quagmire of technologies and we also missed all deadlines. What happened, happened. That’s why the project has to be frozen till better days.

But there is some good news - after all experiments and attempts to make everything work we’ve got an understanding of how to create a better version of Sketch Tales. One of the good variant is to make it more accessible by releasing the game in the form of an online F2P world. With the same history and possibilities.

Our future plan:
1. Frozen the first version of Sketch Tales, as it’s further development in the existing form is impossible 
2. Find  the funding and make the team for the F2P version of the game
3. Develop and release new Sketch Tales
4. For everyone who bought the game, we want to give cool individual awards and bonuses in the new version of a game. Also to provide access to the closed Beta of the new F2P Sketch Tales
5. Keep developing Sketch Tales 

And now, it’s very important to us hear your opinion about this changes. Please write in comments your opinion about restarting Sketch Tales? What are your expectations from the new version of Sketch Tales?

I wanted to thank all who was with us all this time! To people who bought and played our game, left reviews and wrote comments. Even criticism! All this inspires us not to leave behind the project and to move on. Maybe in a new way. We want to make Sketch Tales better and more interesting than ever before.

Thanks to all of you!

Alexey Sityanov
8D studio, project lead

notes.title: Closed Beta Bug Fix
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Sketchers![/h1]

During last week's 'Play with the Devs' session some users were experiencing a frozen loading screen when trying to join an ongoing match. This ended up being a bit of a tricky bug....

To update:: open the game properties in the Steam library and click on 'Check the Cache Integrity' in the Local Files tab.

notes.title: Untitled
Mutpliayer Beta update #2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10001480/7b7f819614c1b33cd1b71fa2662b8faa8fe47902.jpg[/img]

We have some juicy updates for Closed Beta Test that just went live!

Features:
 - Easily join an existing match. You are now able to easily download the map for an existing multiplayer match and join that game
 - Two new official maps. Oh yeah!
 - Magic staffs shooting fireballs and lighting bolts have been added; 
 - Scroll Chests have been added. This is a big one! This is the foundation for  a player being able to "level up" and upgrade the types of characters, weapons, items, fireballs, etc that they will be able to chose for a multiplayer match. Once you find a scroll, you will need to hold on to it until the end of the match and if you do that successfully, that scroll will then be permanently added to your Magic Book
 - Hints added by hotkeys and by the game rules in the mode menu;
 - Record and share your own audio for your characters and creations
 - Changes to make the UI and certain language more intuitive
 - Story Maker has been updated – voxel performance and user-friendly options for compiling the map for multiplayer, map settings, so as the list of hotkeys added to the menu; 

Bugs:
 - Exit ≠ Crash. This is a bug in Unity but we found a work-around that allows you to close the game without it potentially crashing
 - Freezing on loading fixed;

To kick off the update right away, open the game properties in the Steam library and click on 'Check the Cashe Integrity' in the Local Files tab. Once complete, the game will update and you can start enjoying the updates!

P.S.: feel free to write us your feedback on what you like and dislike about the new update. This will help us understand how to make Sketch Tales even better. In the meantime we will keep developing our project and currently we are mainly focused on improving the game’s performance and gameplay.

Have fun and enjoy the game! 
8D Team

notes.title: Multiplayer & Voxel Editor Beta Launches Today!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.giphy.com/AOhgwKMU3OQzm.gif[/img]

Alright alright alright!

For those that signed up for beta access, please check your email for the beta password to check out Sketch Tales in all its new multiplayer glory! Instructions on how to enable the beta are below (and also in the email).

For those that didn't sign up but would like to be added to the next wave, please complete the three brief fields here https://docs.google.com/a/whippering.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd5o0Cv_-KnC6DJo9yovmEZbDwclh1xSDW6CnR9lhYtn0swOw/viewform and we'll get you added.

We're looking forward to seeing you and your imaginative creations out on the battlefield. Also, be sure to use the voxel editor and upload shots of your worlds and maps to the Community Hub on Steam!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/N9sdgj8.gif[/img]

We'll be adding quite a bit to the game while in closed beta. In particular, over the next weeks expect to see major performance improvements and additional multiplayer maps added.

For those with the password, here are the steps on how to enable the multiplayer beta:
[olist]
[*] Locate Sketch Tales in your Steam library
[*] Right click on Sketch Tales
[*] Choose "properties"
[*] Navigate to the betas tab
[*] Enter the password (check your email)
[*] you will see some text that the password worked. That triggered a new option in the menu directly above the password box. Click that menu and select "multiplayerbeta" (If you do not see “multiplayerbeta” as an option, restart Steam, navigate back to this window and it will be present)
[*] Navigate to the “Local Files” Tab 
[*] Click Delete Local Game Content. This will uninstall Sketch Tales 
[*] Once uninstallation is complete, re-install Sketch Tales (you can do this a number of ways. Double clicking on it in your library is an easy one) 
[*] Once installation is complete, you’re good to go. Start the game and enjoy!
[/olist]
------------------
[b]Troubleshooting[/b] 
In some rare cases, Steam will not recognize the beta. If you try to start the game and you receive a message that states you’re missing an executable file, please: 
[olist]
[*] Right click on Sketch Tales
[*] Choose "properties" 
[*] Navigate to the Local Files tab 
[*] Click “Verify Integrity of Game Cache” 
[*] Once complete, start Sketch Tales again  
[/olist]
If you still receive a message stating you’re missing an executable file, please:
[olist]
[*] Right click on Sketch Tales
[*] Choose "properties" 
[*]  Navigate to the Local Files tab 
[*] Click “Delete Local Game Content.” This will uninstall Sketch Tales 
[*] Once complete, reinstall Sketch Tales
[*] Once complete, right click on Sketch Tales
[*] Choose "properties" 
[*] Navigate to the Local Files tab 
[*] Click “Verify Integrity of Game Cache” 
[*] Once complete, start Sketch Tales again
[/olist]

notes.title: Game Updated to v. 0.131 | Игра обновлена до версии 0.131
notes.content:
Hi everybody! 

Today we have a big experimental update for you! Sketch Tales have just been upgraded to version 0.131, bringing along significant changes and improvements.

IMPORTANT! We’ve uploaded this version to an experimental thread in order to test it. If you want to try it out, then right-click Sketch Tales in the games library, choose Properties and “experimental” in the BETAS section and in the section of LOCAL FILES click on "VERIFY INEGRITY OF GAME CACHE ...". Your version will then update to 0.131. 

If all goes well, we will upload this update to the main thread within a few days.

So, what’s new: 

•	The basic amount of energy has been increased to 1000 in Sandbox mode;
•	Until the Sketch Tales main story launch all the paint colors have been made available;
•	Text and voiceover phrases have been put into the same window;
•	AI of the same class no longer attacks the player
•	UNDO is now called by Ctrl+Z;
•	Bug with sprites jerking when tilt fixed;
•	Cloud layers added;
•	Weather effects fixed – now the rain is not pouring so often;
•	Size, strength and speed of monsters have been decreased. 

Additionally, we have carried out lots of optimization work: 

•	Performance has been considerably increased;
•	System requirements lowered to 4Gb of RAM;
•	Drawing distance for geometry, sprites and shadows added to the Settings;
•	Minimum screen resolution of 1024x768 added;
•	Possibility to switch on white plane instead of water added. 

========================================================================

Всем привет! 

Сегодня у нас для вас большое экспериментальное обновление игры! Sketch Tales обновлена до версии 0.131, в которой появилось много изменений и улучшений.  

ВНИМАНИЕ! Версия выложена в экспериментальную ветку, чтобы проверить ее работоспособность.  Если вы хотите получить это обновление, то в библиотеке игр нажмите правой кнопкой мышки на Sketch Tales и в настройках в разделе BETAS выберите «experimental», после чего в разделе LOCAL FILES нажмите "VERIFY INEGRITY OF GAME CACHE..." После этого Ваша версия обновится до 0.131. 

Если все будет Oк, то через пару дней мы выложим обновление в основную ветку.  

Итак, что нового:

•	В sandbox режиме увеличено базовое количество энергии до 1000
•	До старта основной истории Sketch Tales все краски включены сразу
•	Текстовые реплики и звуки соединены в одном окне
•	ИИ того же класса больше не атакует игрока
•	UNDO вызывается по Ctrl+Z 
•	Исправлен баг с дерганьем при наклоне спрайтов
•	Добавлены слои облаков
•	Исправлена погода, теперь дождь не так часто льет
•	Исправлено освещение, теперь не так темно на карте
•	Уменьшены размер, сила и скорость монстров

А также проведено множество улучшений оптимизации игры:

•	Значительно повышена производительность
•	Системные требования снижены до 4gb памяти
•	В настройки добавлены дальность отрисовки геометрии, спрайтов и теней
•	Добавлено минимальное разрешение - 1024x768
•	Добавлена возможность включить белую плоскость вместо воды

•	В настройки добавлены дальность отрисовки геометрии, спрайтов и теней

notes.title: Game Updated to v.0.125 / Игра обновлена до версии 0.125
notes.content:
Play the latest of Sketch Tales! Check out the list of changes in this fresh update: 

- Screen resolution can now be changed directly from the game; 
- Violet-colored water bug has been fixed, now works as due in DX9 version; 
- Depth of Field, an experimental visual effect added. It can be deactivated in the settings; 
- New options for DOF, Noise, VSync, Invert mouse have been added; 
- The adjustment of sounds and music volume has been fixed. 
- Sounds added to the inventory;
- Lighting sources have been somewhat optimized; bonfire shadows have been temporarily switched off.

If you experience troubles with launching the game, try the DX9 version from STEAM library.

================================== 

Играйте в обновленный Скетч Тейлз! Список изменений в новейшем патче:

- Можно менять разрешение прямо из игры
- Исправлена фиолетовая вода, работает в версии dx9
- Добавлен экспериментальный визуальный эффект Depth of Field, его можно отключить в настройках 
- Добавлены новые настройки DOF, Noise, VSync, Invert mouse 
- Исправлена настройка громкости звуков и музыки. 
- Добавлены звуки в инвентарь
- оптимизированы источники освещения, временно отключили тени от костров.

notes.title: Game Build Updated / Первое обновление игры
notes.content:
Greetings to all the doodlers and sketch people! 

Following your first day feedback and bug reports, we have just come up with a game update to fix several issues you helped us find (and many thanks for that!) in the game.

[u]Here’s the list of changes[/u]: 
[list][*]Character select screen – fixed the character selection area
[*]Choice of form blocks - now the form is not converted into basic block during construction
[*]Deleting of character frames has been fixed. Now the deleted frames do not reappear after you restart.[/list]
Thanks for playing so actively and helping us make this project great!

Expect to hear further game updates news soon. Stay tooned!
==========================
Приветствуем всех скетчменов  и воителей кисти! 

По горячим следам первого дня тестирования, спешим порадовать вас обновлением игры. Нам удалось исправить несколько досадных ошибок, которые обнаружились с вашей помощью (за что вам отдельный респект!) в игре. 

[u]Что мы исправили[/u]:
[list][*]Экран выбора персонажа – исправлена область выбора персонажа
[*]Выбор формы блоков – теперь при строительстве формы не превращаются в базовые блоки 
[*]Исправлено удаление кадров у персонажей. Теперь после перезапуска удаленные кадры не появляются.[/list]
Спасибо за активную поддержку и помощь в улучшении проекта! 

Мы уже готовим следующее обновление игры, так что выше кисточки и оставайтесь на связи!

notes.title: Sketch Tales is live on Steam EA! | Sketch Tales появилась в раннем доступе!
notes.content:
Hooray! We did it! Sketch Tales is now live on Steam Early Access! Thanks all for your support! 

Much has been done, yet, there is a ton more to do in future before we can get rid of all nasty bugs and get all those great features, locations, story, monsters etc added to the game. 

Please, check out the Early Access section on the game's page as it explains in detail where we are with the game at the moment. 

To cap it all, Alex Sityanov has recorded a short video to address all the Early Accessers. Enjoy watching and enjoy the game! 

[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aY5xuFmutvc[/url]
--------------------------------------------------

Ура!!! Мы сделали это!!! Позиции злого колдуна ослаблены и самое время выходить на охоту за красками и яркими впечатлениями! Доступ к Sketch Tales в Early Access на Стиме открыт!
Вперед, воины кисти, с карандашами наголо!

Знайте, что мы только в начале своего пути и впереди нам предстоит преодолеть еще множество преград, багов и бессонных ночей, прежде чем зло будет окончательно побеждено и мир снова засияет всеми красками!
